## Checklist

- [ ] The checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/NOALBS/noalbs-cloud/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) pass locally.
- [ ] A schema change is a new migration that works with the previous release.
- [ ] Changed API routes or DTOs: `openapi.json` and `schema.d.ts` are regenerated.
- [ ] Changed what users see or can set: the [docs](https://github.com/NOALBS/noalbs-cloud-docs) need an update (a PR there, or a note here).
- [ ] Mostly AI-generated? Say so (see [AI-assisted contributions](https://github.com/NOALBS/noalbs-cloud/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-assisted-contributions)).
